Enumerate loaded modules in running processes to detect injected DLLs.

description: Enumerate Windows services and identify suspicious entries.

queries.query: Get-Service | Where-Object {$_.StartType -eq 'Automatic'} | Select-Object Name, DisplayName, Status

description: Query recent certutil process executions in event logs.

queries.query: SELECT * FROM Artifact.Windows.EventLogs.Sysmon() WHERE EventID = 1 AND CommandLine =~ 'certutil'
